title: The Real Saint Nick
story_html:
At Christmas, children wait for Saint Nicholas to bring gifts down the chimney. But it's not just a story. Saint Nicholas was a real person.

A long time ago, a man named Marcus occupied a house with his family. He was not modest. He always told everybody he was the strongest man in the province.

He worked hard, but he could barely sustain his family. He wanted to save money and prosper. Still, he could never earn a penny more than he needed.

One day, Marcus made an agreement with a blacksmith. The blacksmith had a lot of work to do, but he couldn't do it all by himself. Marcus wanted to help him forge iron. The blacksmith agreed to compensate him with a lot of money.

In the same town, there was a man named Nicholas. At an early age, Nicholas started preaching. But he also believed that he should be humble and helpful. He learned that helping people gave him even more satisfaction than preaching.

One day, Nicholas encountered Marcus. Marcus told Nicholas about his agreement with the blacksmith. "I worked hard for him," Marcus said, "but a problem arose. Even though I worked for him, he didn't pay me."

Nicholas wanted to help Marcus. That night, he went back to Marcus's house. He brought a bag of gold. It exceeded the amount that Marcus needed. Nicholas climbed up a ladder and dropped the bag of gold down the chimney. Marcus thanked his benefactor.

Soon, people found out about Nicholas's gift. He became well known and loved. Even today, people still give secret gifts to children. And we say they are from Saint Nicholas.

questions.q: At Christmas, what do children wait for Saint Nicholas to do?
opts: To sing songs at their door
To bring gifts down the chimney
To leave food on the table
To light the Christmas tree

questions.q: What did Marcus always tell everybody?
opts: That he was the richest man in town
That he was a famous blacksmith
That he was Saint Nicholas
That he was the strongest man in the province

questions.q: In the story, 'sustain his family' means:
opts: to support his family with enough money and food
to move his family to a new town
to teach his family a trade
to protect his family from danger

questions.q: Why did the blacksmith need Marcus's help?
opts: He was too old to work
He wanted to learn to forge iron
He had a lot of work but couldn't do it all by himself
He was going away on a trip

questions.q: What did the blacksmith agree to do for Marcus?
opts: Give Marcus a house
Teach Marcus how to preach
Make Marcus his partner
Compensate him with a lot of money

questions.q: What gave Nicholas even more satisfaction than preaching?
opts: Earning money
Helping people
Traveling around the province
Making gifts

questions.q: What problem did Marcus tell Nicholas about?
opts: The blacksmith did not pay him for his work
His house had burned down
He had lost a bag of gold
His family was sick

questions.q: How did Nicholas give the gold to Marcus?
opts: He left it at the front door
He gave it to the blacksmith to deliver
He climbed a ladder and dropped it down the chimney
He hid it in Marcus's garden
a person who repairs houses
a person who tells stories
a person who works with iron
a person who helps others by giving money or gifts

questions.q: Why do people today say that secret gifts are from Saint Nicholas?
opts: Because Nicholas became well known and loved for secretly giving a gift
Because Nicholas asked people to use his name
Because Marcus told everyone to say it
Because the blacksmith started the tradition
